description: Discard exactly one pending, explicitly requested enrollment capture. It does not remove enrolled speakers or require a microphone/session. Call speaker.list and copy its pending_captures[].capture_id. The host asks the operator to confirm the exact selection. No audio, embedding or path is accepted.

capture_id.description: Exact opaque handle returned by speaker.list; never invent it or reuse the illustrative hexadecimal ID in examples.
